claim_summary: Plan ARIA-V7 — Autonomous Runtime Completeness. V6 closed the architectural arc (Tier-1 contracts + 23 invariants); the POST-V6 30-cycle smoke + 10-validator audit revealed that V5/V6 contracts are correctly wired at the test boundary but runtime data does not flow through them in autonomous mode. ORPHAN-HIGH-079 crash (orchestrator hardcoded plan_seed sentinel → plan_convergence validator rejects → cycle crash at Gate A); V6.2 run_convergent_authoring is dead code (zero production callsites); V6.4 auto-promote precision_history is never populated; specialist + drafter + judge envelopes are minted but never claimed (no consumer). V7 wires the PRODUCERS for every V5/V6 contract across 8 commits: cycle_runner plan synthesis (C1) + orchestrator try/except invalid-plan handling (C2) + universal agent dispatcher (C3) + skill_genesis_drainer (C4) + corpus-aware + evidence-pack pre-flight (C5) + calibration_reporter orchestrator phase (C6) + reflection v3 + analyzer + cycle watchdog (C7) + F-013 RESOLVED + 30-cycle hard-gate verification (C8). Operator vision principle: 'yama yok, susturma yok, kör bırakma yok, sonraya bırakma yok — her zaman mımarı cozum'. V7 v2 audit-revised plan addressed 5 BLOCKING gaps + 3 underspec items + 2 banned-phrase removals + 1 verification hardening before C1 implementation began.
